DirectAdmin is a web hosting control panel.

| Key | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `host` | `string` | ServerURL should be the hostname (with port if necessary) of the DirectAdmin instance you are trying to use |
| `user` | `string` | User should be the DirectAdmin username that the Login Key is created under |
| `login_key` | `string` | LoginKey is used for authentication The key will need two permissions: `CMD_API_SHOW_DOMAINS` `CMD_API_DNS_CONTROL` Unless you are only using `GetRecords()`, in which case `CMD_API_DNS_CONTROL` can be omitted |


Selectel provides cloud infrastructure services.

| Key | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `user` | `string` |  |
| `password` | `string` |  |
| `account_id` | `string` |  |
| `project_name` | `string` |  |
| `KeystoneToken` | `string` |  |
| `ZonesCache` | `map[string]string` |  |

```sh
LIBDNS_PROVIDER_NAME=selectel
LIBDNS_PROVIDER_CONFIG='{"KeystoneToken":"","ZonesCache":null,"account_id":"","password":"","project_name":"","user":""}'
```

## timeweb

[https://timeweb.com/](https://timeweb.com/) · [github.com/libdns/timeweb](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/libdns/timeweb)

Timeweb provides web hosting and domain services.

| Key | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ApiURL` | `string` |  |
| `ApiToken` | `string` |  |

```sh
LIBDNS_PROVIDER_NAME=timeweb
LIBDNS_PROVIDER_CONFIG='{"ApiToken":"","ApiURL":""}'
```

## vercel

[https://vercel.com/](https://vercel.com/) · [github.com/libdns/vercel](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/libdns/vercel)

Vercel provides web hosting and domain services.

| Key | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `auth_api_token` | `string` | AuthAPIToken is the Vercel Authentication Token - see https://vercel.com/docs/api#api-basics/authentication |

```sh
LIBDNS_PROVIDER_NAME=vercel
LIBDNS_PROVIDER_CONFIG='{"auth_api_token":""}'
```
